Patient_Actor.history: A 55-year-old man presents to his primary care physician for diarrhea. He states that he has experienced roughly 10 episodes of non-bloody and watery diarrhea every day for the past 3 days. The patient has a past medical history of IV drug abuse and recently completed treatment for an abscess with cellulitis. His vitals are notable for a pulse of 105/min. Physical exam reveals diffuse abdominal discomfort with palpation but no focal tenderness. A rectal exam is within normal limits and is Guaiac negative. Which of the following is the best initial treatment for this patient?
